subject: reasoning
question:
Who lives two floors below Anjali's floor?

Comprehension: Eight persons Anjali, Binu, Chirag, Deepa, Esha, Firoz, Gita and Hari lives on eight floors (1-8). Gita lives on even floor but not 6th. Hari lives below Chirag. Esha lives two floors above Binu. Anjali lives on even floor but not adjacent to Esha. Gita lives just above Firoz. Chirag lives on 3rd floor. Esha not on top. Deepa not adjacent to Binu.
solution:
Eight persons Anjali, Binu, Chirag, Deepa, Esha, Firoz, Gita and Hari lives on eight floors.

1. Chirag lives on 3rd floor. 

2. Hari lives below Chirag. Esha lives two floors above Binu. Esha not on top. 

3. Anjali lives on even floor but not adjacent to Esha. Gita lives just above Firoz. 

4. Gita lives on even floor but not 6th. Deepa not adjacent to Binu.
